subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Bugs Bunny and Cartoon Tricksters
description: One-minute skill: Bugs Bunny and Cartoon Tricksters.

hook.text: Bugs Bunny outsmarts every opponent: hunters, opera singers, aliens. He never throws a punch—only wit.

buildup.text: He cross-dresses, breaks the fourth wall, and redefines every situation. Classic trickster behavior, animated.

discovery.text: Chuck Jones modeled Bugs on the trickster archetype explicitly. Bugs is Br'er Rabbit in a cartoon body.

twist.text: Bugs only fights when provoked. He never starts conflict—he finishes it. The trickster defends, not attacks.

climax.text: Cartoon tricksters taught millions of children the oldest lesson in mythology: brains beat brawn every time.
